notes.title: Construction mode has been removed and the game has become Free!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after a long time I decided to remove the construction mode and also make the game free.

So you can start the game right now!

notes.title: Screaming Noppy: Platformer where you control the character with sounds
notes.notes:
🎤🔊 [b]Scream Your Way[/b] to Glory in 'Screaming Noppy'! 🌟🔊

Get ready to embark on a gaming journey like never before! 'Screaming Noppy' is not just a platformer; it's a symphony of sound and creativity. 🚀

🗣️[b] Unleash the Power of Your Voice:[/b]
In this groundbreaking game, your microphone is your joystick. Shout, laugh, even burp - use every sound at your disposal to guide Noppy through 35 mind-bending levels. It's not just a game; it's an auditory adventure! 🗣️🎮

🌈 [b]Create Your Sonic Masterpiece:[/b]
For the builders and creators, 'Screaming Noppy' introduces a level editor. Craft your own challenging levels and share them with the world! Will your friends conquer your creations or succumb to the symphony of chaos you've composed? 🎼🎮

👑 [b]Dress for Success:[/b]
Earn headgear rewards by conquering levels and dress up your Noppy in style. Stand out in the sonic crowd and let the world see your unique flair! 🎩💥

🌟 [b]Easy to Play, Tricky to Master:[/b]
With levels that strike the perfect balance between entertainment and challenge, 'Screaming Noppy' guarantees hours of fun. It's not just about screaming; it's about strategy and skill! 🤯🕹️

🎁 [b]Unlock Secrets and Easter Eggs:[/b]
Discover hidden levels, unlock rewards, and revel in the joy of finding Easter eggs scattered throughout the game. The adventure doesn't end at the portal - there's always more to explore! 🕵️‍♂️🎉

🚀 [b]Join the Sonic Revolution:[/b]
Are you ready to redefine gaming? Join the 'Screaming Noppy' revolution, where your voice is the key to success. It's not just a game; it's an echo of triumph! 🎤🏆

🔗 [b]Share Your Screams:[/b]
Connect with fellow gamers, share your experiences, and challenge friends to conquer your sonic creations. The 'Screaming Noppy' community is waiting for you! 🤝🌐

🎮 [b]Screaming Noppy[/b] - Where Sound meets Adventure. Are you loud enough to conquer it all? 🔊👾

🌐 [b]Streamers:[/b]
Explore our collection of the most thrilling moments on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/stories/highlights/17931406679231685/]Instagram[/url]. Relive the excitement, discover new strategies, and challenge yourself to match the vocal skills that turned these streamers into 'Screaming Noppy' legends! 🎬🕹️

notes.title: Update - "Build, Build and Build Again"
notes.notes:
What has been added and changed?

[b]Blocks:[/b]
- 10 new blocks have been added.

[b]Traps:[/b]
- 3 new traps have been added.

[b]Chapter:[/b]
- A new section has been added - "Other things", it will contain mostly useful and harmless things.
Other things:
- Added 2 new things
1) Gives the player vulnerability to traps for 5 seconds - "yes, it's banal, but cool."
2) 4 blocks that allow you to accelerate the character in one of 4 directions.

[b]Technical questions:[/b]
- The ability to see how long a block takes when you want to delete it has been added.
- A new parameter has appeared in the settings that allows you to change controls from voice to mouse.
- When publishing a level, now instead of a screenshot of the level, you can upload almost any of your pictures.
- A tutorial has been added when the player starts the build mode for the first time.
- Fixed 10 small bugs.
